completion:
Review the completed incident report for completeness and accuracy.
3. Review the detailed information for each of the seven categories of incidents.
4. Contact employee, supervisor, and witnesses for additional information, if needed.
5. Ensure that supervisor or responsible person and dates are entered.
6. When complete upload incident to WoundCareTracker (WCT).

WOUND CARE WORKBOOK RED • 3/2Visits to high-risk clinics will add paper copy of incident report and/or any additional documents required (Determiners, Witnesses, Faxes, etc.)

On-site Quality Advisor will provide tracking tool to record clinic name and date for database tracking.

Quality Advisors shall complete any additional documentation needed per the appendix and provide this with the incident report.

All documentation to be kept in the WoundCareTracker (WCT) system. # Provider
